samples.name: prop-tree-stump
samples.prompt: ONE transparent RPG world prop. Low cut tree stump with light growth rings on the top and a few wood chips around it. Brown bark, light tan exposed cut surface. Reference images are Kenney Tiny Town and Tiny Farm style guides; match their very simple low resolution pixel art. Intended 16x16 logical pixels enlarged, square canvas, full object centered with narrow transparent margin. Broad flat pixel clusters, few muted colors, no gradients or fine texture. Readable at tiny native size. No glow, no colored outline fringe, no text, no background scene or ground tile. Slight overhead view matching references.
